summary: The 24K Magic World Tour was Bruno Mars's fourth concert tour. It supported his third album, 24K Magic. It ran from March 2017 to December 2018. It covered Europe, the Americas, Asia and Oceania. It included his first African show, in Morocco. Openers included Anderson .Paak, Camila Cabello and Dua Lipa. Boyz II Men and others replaced Cardi B on a 2018 leg. Over one million tickets sold in one day. The setlist mixed 24K Magic with earlier hits. It included "Uptown Funk", his collaboration with Mark Ronson. Mars performed with his eight-piece band, The Hooligans. Mars and Phil Tayag choreographed the dances. LeRoy Bennett handled production and lighting design. A stage fire forced an evacuation in Glasgow in 2018. Nobody was injured. Critics praised his showmanship, guitar solos and staging. The tour grossed over $396 million. It is one of the highest-grossing tours of all time. It won two Pollstar awards and two Billboard Music Awards.
